» AQ® Plus
With decades of experience in the development and production of natural and highly functional fruit fibers, we set the standard in the industry with Herbacel® AQ® Plus Citrus. Herbacel® AQ® Plus Citrus is known for its outstanding functional properties and consistent quality.
Whether texturizing, stabilizing, emulsifying or adjusting viscosity, Herbacel® AQ® Plus Citrus can help you develop products that meet your functional needs.
» Herbacel® AQ® Plus are fibers obtained from freshly harvested, juiced (and de-oiled), and gently dried citrus fruits.
The citrus fibers are characterized by very high water-binding and water-retaining capacities. These highly functional and neutral-tasting fruit fibers can emulsify and form smooth, soft textures.
Benefits and positive
properties of Herbacel® AQ® Plus
* Highly functional fruit fiber
* High water-binding capacity
* Optimal texturing
* Stable emulsions
* Excellent cold swelling properties
* Pulpiness and smooth mouthfeel
* Process-stable (heat-stable, shear-stable)
* Different particle sizes available
* Suitable for reformulation concepts (salt, fat and sugar reduction)
* Potential substitution of thickeners, stabilizers and emulsifiers
* Clean Labeling as “citrus fiber”
**Optimized Food for health-conscious consumers
** with multifunctional citrus fibers
Reformulation of food products
Our HERBACEL® AQ® PLUS range meets all these requirements thanks to its excellent nutritional, functional and sensory properties. The benefits of our multifunctional citrus fibers therefore make HERBACEL® AQ® PLUS so valuable and versatile for food production.
They unfold their effects where existing formulations need to be improved and reconsidered in terms of nutritional optimization. HERBACEL® AQ® PLUS meets the challenge of creating full-bodied foods with intense flavor, while reducing fat, sugar and salt content.

The importance of functional fibers
Versatile and beneficial in the food industry
Our citrus fibres are ideal for binding water, texturizing, emulsifying and stabilizing foods. This makes them a multifunctional natural ingredient.
The high water binding capacity of the fibers leads to an improved texture and consistency of the food.
The emulsifying property ensures an even distribution of fat in products such as dressings or sauces.
The citrus fibers are neutral in taste. As a result, they can optimize fat, salt or sugar-reduced alternatives that offer consumers the same organoleptic impressions as conventional products.

Herbacel® AQ® AFB-200 – Functional apple fiber – Enhanced texturizer – Color
05 Oct. 22
Apple fibers are often used as bulk fiber for enrichment. Herbafood has widened its range of high functional fruit fibers and designed a new generation of apple fibers with additional functional benefits.
Compared to conventional dietary apple fibers, our Herbacel® AQ® A FB-200 offers high water binding capacity combined with excellent swelling property at cold and warm temperatures.
These properties of the new apple fiber offers benefits in diverse food applications such as meat products, meat alternatives and baked goods.
The use of functional apple fiber is also advantageous to improve the free flowing behaviour in powdered products and to minimize the anti-caking effect in fruit pieces.
Besides its high water-binding capacity, Herbacel® AQ® AFB-200 provides a golden-brown hue in your food product.
Especially in baked goods and meat alternatives, it is beneficial in order to support brown colorings. Also, in plant-based dairy products Herbacel ® AQ® AFB 200 is recommended to avoid greyish off-shades that can occur from alternative protein sources.
